what: Stage 1 vertical-stack budgets for biomes/springhollows (Sikwingi-Khaloyi): 4 station HTML pages (< 2.0 MB each via .tex.springhollows.js sidecar), max samplers <= 15, and estimated VRAM <= 380 MB.

springhollows.html.why: Station 1 (spring): Cav Ozarks Resurgence 24 m cave mouth, sapphire mammoth-spring boil, bald-cypress gallery & tufabryum curtains with sidecar textures.

springhollows-shutin.html.why: Station 2 (shutin): Ching-Ma purple-red rhyolite porphyry shut-in gorge, whitewater chutes, dolomite benches & boat-lift reserve with sidecar textures.

springhollows-fenestre.html.why: Station 3 (fenestre): Collapsed 18 m sinkhole skylight & walk-in KSPELEO.CALCITE 14 m celestine/calcite/onyx crystal cavern with sidecar textures.

springhollows-glade.html.why: Station 4 (glade): Cherty-dolomite & red-porphyry glade, saffron/whorl-olive terraces, onyx chert-bridge hollow & Ancient bleach-scar with sidecar textures.

*.why: Shared .tex.springhollows.js texture sidecar pack serving all four Springhollows station pages.
